description.value: Sundance Liquor Store is a village retail shop within the Sun Peaks Resort, located in the Residences at Sun Peaks Grand building. It carries wine, beer, coolers, ciders, and spirits, with a selection of over 200 different wines. For touring cyclists passing through or staying at Sun Peaks, it serves as a convenient spot to pick up drinks after a day on the trails or bike park.

address.value: 3250 Village Way, Sun Peaks, BC V0E 5N0
